title: Add a text utilities module
idea: Add a small text utilities module under src/text/: slugify(s) (lower-case, words joined by single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen), truncate(s, max) (at most max characters, ending with an ellipsis character when shortened), and an index.js that re-exports both. Add tests in test/text.test.js.

reference.src/text/index.js:
export { slugify } from './slugify.js';
export { truncate } from './truncate.js';
